title: Power of Two
description:
Given an integer `n`, return `true` if it is a power of two. Otherwise, return `false`.

An integer `n` is a power of two if there exists an integer `x` such that `n == 2^x`.

**Bit trick:** A power of two has exactly one `1` bit in its binary representation.

```text
1  = 0001  →  power of 2 (2^0)
2  = 0010  →  power of 2 (2^1)
4  = 0100  →  power of 2 (2^2)
3  = 0011  →  NOT a power of 2 (two 1-bits)

Key insight: n & (n - 1) == 0 iff n has exactly one 1-bit.
  4: 0100 & 0011 = 0000  →  true
  6: 0110 & 0101 = 0100  →  false
```

**Edge case:** `n <= 0` is never a power of two.
